evidence.quote: Teaching language German English Languages Courses are held in English and German.
Around half of the courses are taught in English.
Application period for the winter semester 2027/28: 2 May to 15 July 2027

notes: Tuition: the 800 EUR/semester fee for third-country students is a THI-wide figure confirmed for Bachelor programmes; no page states it specifically for Global Economics and Business Management. A Moroccan applicant with a Moroccan Baccalauréat does not appear in the documented exemption list (German/EU/EEA, German qualification holders, etc.), so the fee is retained. Documents: the DAAD page and the application page do not explicitly list documents for this programme; ui-assist is stated only for the preliminary review of foreign certificates. Intakes: only the winter semester 2027/28 deadline is stated; no start date or opening date is given, and the DAAD page's 2 May–15 July window lacks a year, so it was not used. Language: the DAAD page calls the programme German-language and requires German B2; the eighth-semester language (French/Spanish/Chinese) is an additional language and is not counted as a teaching language. Writing the Bachelor's thesis in English is a component, not the programme language. English B2: the DAAD page says 'no proof required' while calling it required/recommended; left as a manual check.

evidence.quote: German language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: Deutsches Sprachdiplom der Kultusministerkonferenz (DSD): DSD II Reading: B2 Listening: B2 Speaking: B2 Writing: B2 Deutsche Sprachprüfung für den Hochschulzugang (DSH): DSH-1 Goethe-Zertifikat: Goethe-Zertifikat B2 telc Deutsch: telc Deutsch B2 TestDaF: TDN 3 Reading: TDN 3 Listening: TDN 3 Speaking: TDN 3 Writing: TDN 3 ÖSD Zertifikat: C2
applicants from non-German-speaking countries applying for a German-language degree programme like this must provide proof of sufficient knowledge of the German language with level B2.

note.fr: Vérifiez la page de candidature pour connaître la liste complète des documents et les modalités de soumission (le DAAD ne liste pas les pièces).
note.en: Check the application page for the full document list and submission rules (the DAAD page does not list the documents).

evidence.quote: Applicants who did not acquire the higher secondary school-leaving certificate in Germany or at a school with the German "Abitur" examination rules will have to send their documents to uni-assist for preliminary inspection prior to their application at THI.

note.fr: Le DAAD indique que l'anglais B2 est requis ou recommandé sans preuve, mais aucune autre page du dossier n'énonce de condition d'anglais pour ce programme — vérifiez auprès de l'université.
note.en: The DAAD page says English B2 is required/recommended with no proof, but no other page in the dossier states an English condition for this programme — verify with the university.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required/recommended, no proof required

note.fr: La durée de 7 semestres (3,5 ans) figure sur la page DAAD et sur la page de l'université, mais la seconde donne 210 ECTS ; le statut des 30 ECTS manquants (semestre de stage à l'étranger) n'est pas précisé.
note.en: The 7-semester (3.5-year) duration appears on both the DAAD and university pages, but the latter gives 210 ECTS; the status of the missing 30 ECTS (internship semester abroad) is not specified.
